# Test machines

`ux8406ca/` is the part of `/sys` of a UX8406CA that the program reads: the
product name, and the i2c devices with the two touch controllers. The ids of
the controllers are those of the machine on which the GNOME extension was
tested (`gnome-keys/tests/touch.test.js` of cceelen/gnome-extension). The tests derive other machines from
this tree.
